transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi — I want to redo my flat in Aundh. 3BHK, about 1,100 sq ft. What might it cost?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Our pricing depends on the materials and scope — the designers go through that at the consultation. What are you planning?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room. But seriously — can’t you give me even a rough range? I just want to know if we’re in the same ballpark.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I really can’t give a number that would mean anything without seeing the site and the spec. The difference between a standard and a premium kitchen alone can be 3× the cost. The consultation is free — the designer will give you a proper number by the end of it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. What days work for you?
